title: TravelAI buys and relaunches Sonder.com as AI-powered urban stay guide
excerpt: The deal only involves Sonder's intellectual property and brand.
content_html:
Umesh Ellichipuram

Tue, July 28, 2026 at 7:16 AM PDT 2 min read

TravelAI, the operating name of UpNext Ventures and its subsidiaries, has purchased the Sonder brand assets.

The acquired assets include the Sonder word mark, related global trademark registrations and a portfolio of domains, notably Sonder.com.

The transaction is limited to Sonder's brand and intellectual property. Sonder's operating business, such as properties, leases, inventory or staff, were not part of the deal.

Following the acquisition, Sonder.com has been relaunched as a curated guide to urban accommodation including apartment-style homes and boutique hotels.

It will serve as a consumer brand built on the "memory infrastructure" TravelAI is developing for the travel industry.

TravelAI co-founder and CEO John Lyotier said: "Sonder earned something rare: a name people remember and a standard of taste they trusted.

"We did not acquire a portfolio of buildings. We acquired the one travel brand whose name already means what we are building with our memory infrastructure.

"Where the old Sonder's technology once lived in the lock on the door, it now lives in discovery, memory, and AI-enabled personalisation."

Sonder was founded in Montreal in 2014 and later listed on Nasdaq, becoming one of the most recognised names in its segment.

The brand now becomes part of a growing portfolio of travel brands that TravelAI has acquired and revived in recent years, including Casai, Smartours and OwnerDirect.

In its new iteration, Sonder is curating places to stay in Amsterdam, Barcelona, Boston, Chicago, Dubai, London, Miami, New York, and most major urban centres worldwide.

Lyotier added: "We intend to treat the brand with the respect it deserves: keeping what made it Sonder, and giving it a future. This is a new chapter, written with care, for the one that came before."

"TravelAI buys and relaunches Sonder.com as AI-powered urban stay guide" was originally created and published by Hotel Management Network, a GlobalData owned brand.

content_html_zh:
乌梅什·埃利奇普拉姆

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二上午 7:16 阅读 2 分钟

TravelAI（UpNext Ventures 及其子公司的运营名称）已购买 Sonder 品牌资产。

收购的资产包括 Sonder 文字商标、相关的全球商标注册和一系列域名，尤其是 Sonder.com。

此次交易仅限于盛达澳的品牌和知识产权。 Sonder 的经营业务，如财产、租赁、库存或员工，不属于交易的一部分。

收购后，Sonder.com 重新推出，成为城市住宿（包括公寓式住宅和精品酒店）的精选指南。

它将作为一个建立在 TravelAI 为旅游行业开发的“记忆基础设施”之上的消费品牌。

TravelAI 联合创始人兼首席执行官 John Lyotier 表示：“Sonder 赢得了一些罕见的东西：人们记住的名字和他们信任的品味标准。

“我们没有收购建筑物组合。 我们收购了一个旅游品牌，它的名字已经意味着我们正在用我们的记忆基础设施构建什么。

“旧 Sonder 的技术曾经存在于门锁中，现在它存在于发现、记忆和人工智能支持的个性化中。”

Sonder 于 2014 年在蒙特利尔成立，后来在纳斯达克上市，成为该领域最知名的品牌之一。

该品牌现已成为 TravelAI 近年来收购和复兴的不断增长的旅游品牌组合的一部分，其中包括 Casai、Smartours 和 OwnerDirect。

在新的迭代中，Sonder 正在策划阿姆斯特丹、巴塞罗那、波士顿、芝加哥、迪拜、伦敦、迈阿密、纽约和全球大多数主要城市中心的住宿地点。

Lyotier 补充道：“我们打算给予该品牌应有的尊重：保留 Sonder 的特色，并赋予它未来。 这是新的一章，是为前一章精心写成的。”

“TravelAI 收购并重新推出 Sonder.com，作为人工智能驱动的城市住宿指南”最初由 GlobalData 旗下品牌 Hotel Management Network 创建和发布。
